userManual.title: User Manual
userManual.subtitle: Complete guide for employees and administrators
userManual.homePageDesc: Open the application URL, select your preferred language, then click "Book Now" to create a new booking or "Manage Booking" to view/change existing bookings.
userManual.restriction1: 3-Day Booking Window: You can only book for today, tomorrow, or the day after tomorrow (maximum 3 days in advance)
userManual.restriction2: 2-Hour Prior Booking: You can only book slots that are at least 2 hours in the future
userManual.restriction3: The calendar will only show available dates within the 3-day window
userManual.bookingStep1: Click "Book Now" on the home page
userManual.bookingStep2: Select your name from the dropdown or search by name
userManual.bookingStep4: Select the booking date from the calendar (only shows today + 2 days)
userManual.bookingStep5: Choose a time slot from available slots (green = available, red = fully booked)
userManual.bookingStep6: Enter number of guests (pax) - Maximum 50 guests
userManual.bookingStep10: Agree to the terms and conditions
userManual.bookingStep13: Save your Booking Number for future reference
userManual.managingBookingsDesc: To view or change your existing bookings, click "Manage Booking" on the home page and enter your booking number. You can request date/time changes or cancel your booking.
userManual.changeRequestsDesc: You can request to change your booking date or time. Changes require admin approval. Submit your request at least 2 hours before your current slot.
userManual.cleanupChecklistDesc: After using the kitchen, complete the cleanup checklist: kitchen cleaned, equipment returned, gas turned off, trash disposed, surfaces wiped. Upload a photo of the clean kitchen.
userManual.employeeWorkflowDesc: Open App → Click Book Now → Fill Details → Sign → Receive Booking Number via Email → Use Kitchen → Complete Cleanup → Book Again
userManual.completedDesc: Booking has been used and cleanup verified
userManual.noShowDesc: Employee did not show up for the booking
userManual.bookEarlyDesc: Book your slot in advance to ensure availability
userManual.saveBookingNumberDesc: Save your booking number securely - it will be sent to your email after booking (check spam folder if not in inbox)
userManual.completeCleanupDesc: Always complete the cleanup checklist to avoid blocking future bookings
userManual.requestChangesEarlyDesc: If you need to change your booking, request changes as early as possible
userManual.checkAvailabilityDesc: Use the calendar to check slot availability before booking
userManual.contactAdminDesc: If you need help, contact admin instead of making multiple bookings

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Common questions about the booking system
faq.q1: How do I book the kitchen?
faq.a1: Click Book Now on the home page, select your name, choose a date and time slot, enter guest count and contact details, agree to terms, sign, and submit. Your booking number will be sent to your email.
faq.q2: How far in advance can I book?
faq.a2: You can book up to 3 days in advance (today, tomorrow, or day after tomorrow). For today's bookings, you must book at least 2 hours before the slot.
faq.q3: How do I cancel my booking?
faq.a3: Go to Manage Booking, enter your booking number, and click Cancel Booking. You can cancel up to 2 hours before your slot.
faq.q4: Can I change my booking time?
faq.a4: Yes, use "Manage Booking" to request a date/time change. Changes require admin approval and must be requested at least 2 hours before your current slot.
faq.q5: What happens if I don't complete the cleanup?
faq.a5: You won't be able to make new bookings until you complete the cleanup checklist and upload a photo for your previous booking.
faq.q6: How many guests can I bring?
faq.q7: How do I access the admin dashboard?
faq.a7: Click Admin on the home page and enter your admin email. Only authorized administrators can access the dashboard.
